results.detail: Unit [1] part (1) and unit [2] (connection, DTSID, Unsupported SQL, SDK via CRM.Proxy ExecuteMultipleExtension RequestType.Update, config file) verified. flow_he items verified. short_he states without condition that the value written to the agent is the partial sum of the last processed combination and not the agent's total. This holds only when the agent appears in more than one agent+agency combination that passes the having filter. For an agent with a single combination the written value is the full sum of that combination (all its direct and parent-contract funds).
